Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support is bent, with the hood latch and both headlamp
assemblies broken away from their mounts. The damage pattern lines up well with a frontal impact at low speed, and nothing I
found points to odler damage on the vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, radiator support, hood latch,
and headlamps, followed by a realignment of the hood and fender gaps and a refinish of the front end. The labor hours requested
match what this kind of work normally takes. The invoices submitted show each part and operation billed once, with no repeated
charges.
